title: Phaser 3 engine running as a live self-playing demo inside the Reddit feed (Devvit). Full write-up + a Claude skill to one-shot it
author: Cminus19
selftext:
Tipsey (r/tipsey) now runs its engine as an attract demo right in the post card it’s not a video or  a screenshot.  The game playing itself behind the Start button. Works in the feed, on web, and in the native Reddit app.  
Getting there took six failures that were all completely silent, including two platform behaviors that aren’t really documented anywhere.  
1.Devvit’s webview CSP refuses all inline <script> blocks — no error on device, your code just never runs  
2. The native Reddit app swallows window.postMessage entirely. works on web reddit, dead in the app, no error  
Full write-up with the architecture, all six failures in order, the CSP-faithful test server, the self-hiding diagnostic strip that cracked the last one.

https://cal-starfur.github.io/Tipsy/docs/live-splash-on-devvit.html

If you use Claude, there’s a downloadable SKILL.md at the bottom of the page that packages the whole workflow.
